title: Learning U-Statistics with Active Inference
one_line_what_it_does: AIPW U-statistic: plug-in U-stat over all predicted labels plus IPW correction over labelled tuples (weights 1/prod pi); optimal sampling rule; asymptotic normality; examples Gini, Kendall tau, Wilcoxon; iid units, independent Bernoulli labelling via coupled uniforms
bears_on_which_part_of_claim: PPI/rectifier for pairwise (U-statistic) estimands needing both members labelled; variance-optimal label allocation. No dependence between units, no graph kernel, no block designs

title: Semi-Supervised U-statistics
one_line_what_it_does: Semi-supervised U-statistics using unlabeled data and prediction tools; asymptotic normality, efficiency, minimax bounds, refined bivariate-kernel estimator
bears_on_which_part_of_claim: Semi-supervised/PPI-type estimator for U-statistics (iid, no spatial structure, no designs)

title: A Unified Framework for Semiparametrically Efficient Semi-Supervised Learning
one_line_what_it_does: Efficiency bound and estimators for semi-supervised inference incl. M-estimation, U-statistics, ATE; subsumes PPI
bears_on_which_part_of_claim: General theory covering U-statistics under iid labelling

title: Dirichlet Meets Horvitz and Thompson: Estimating Homophily in Large Networks via Sampling
one_line_what_it_does: HT estimator of graph Dirichlet energy (edge total of squared neighbour differences, Moran/Geary-type numerator) under general network sampling designs (induced subgraph, traceroute) with joint inclusion probs and variance estimator
bears_on_which_part_of_claim: Design-based unbiased estimation and variance of neighbour-graph pairwise functionals from sampled nodes; no predictions/rectifier, no spatial residual dependence, no block-size optimisation

title: Design-Based Prediction-Powered Inference for Spatial Data (v1); v2 retitled: Conditional validity of PPI for spatially dependent finite populations
one_line_what_it_does: Design-based PPI on a fixed spatial population: exact design variances under SRS/stratified, threshold when blocked spatial balance pays, anticipated-variance-optimal allocation via semivariogram, sandwich inference for estimated propensities; Moran's I used only as a diagnostic of rectifier dependence
bears_on_which_part_of_claim: Block-vs-scattered labelling trade-off and design-variance in spatial PPI, but only for means/linear functionals/regression coefficients, not pairwise or neighbour-graph estimands

title: Spatially Robust Inference with Predicted and Missing at Random Labels
one_line_what_it_does: Doubly robust cross-fitted PPI with jackknife spatial HAC variance; soft-block (clustered) sampling simulations; MAR labelling
bears_on_which_part_of_claim: Spatially dependent PPI under clustered samples for means/regression; no pairwise estimands

title: Cluster-Robust Prediction-Powered Inference
one_line_what_it_does: Cluster-robust PPI++ with partially labelled clusters; labelling-design dependence of precision; power tuning
bears_on_which_part_of_claim: Known background in project (clusters, labelling design); not pairwise

title: Prediction-powered inference for time series across space
authors: Rizvi, Burt, Srinivasan, Berlinghieri, Del Col et al.
one_line_what_it_does: HAC-PPI for temporally dependent data; compares chunked vs interleaved split of labelled data for fitting vs rectifying
bears_on_which_part_of_claim: Chunk-vs-interleave labelling choice under dependence, but for fit/rectify split and means

title: Counting Motifs with Graph Sampling
one_line_what_it_does: Statistical theory for estimating motif counts from subgraph/neighbourhood sampling; HT estimator and optimality
bears_on_which_part_of_claim: Estimating edge/motif functionals of a graph from sampled nodes (no predictions, no spatial)

title: Econometrics of Sampled Networks
one_line_what_it_does: Bias of network statistics under induced/star subgraph sampling and corrections
bears_on_which_part_of_claim: Network functionals from sampled nodes (econometrics vocabulary)

title: Network Sampling: From Static to Streaming Graphs
one_line_what_it_does: Survey of node/edge/induced-subgraph sampling algorithms
bears_on_which_part_of_claim: Graph sampling designs vocabulary

title: Scaling-up Empirical Risk Minimization: Optimization of Incomplete U-statistics
one_line_what_it_does: HT estimators over sampled tuples (incomplete U-statistics) under survey schemes with pair inclusion probabilities
bears_on_which_part_of_claim: Design-based sampling of pairs for U-statistics (computational motivation)

title: Doing well with less! On Sampling Techniques for Empirical Pairwise Loss Estimation/Minimization
one_line_what_it_does: Survey-sampling plans that target pairs vs observations for pairwise losses; HT with pair inclusion probabilities and auxiliary info
bears_on_which_part_of_claim: Pair-vs-node sampling for pairwise functionals, no ML-prediction rectifier/spatial

title: Exact variance estimation for model-assisted survey estimators using U- and V-statistics
one_line_what_it_does: Casts model-assisted (GREG) estimators as U/V-statistics for exact variance
bears_on_which_part_of_claim: Uses U-statistics for variance of survey estimator, not pairwise estimands

title: Variance estimation for complex statistics and estimators: linearization and residual techniques
one_line_what_it_does: Linearisation variance for non-linear statistics (Gini etc.) under complex designs incl. multistage
bears_on_which_part_of_claim: Classical route to variance of ratio/pairwise statistics such as Moran's I under complex designs

title: Robust Inference for Dyadic Data with Spatially Dependent Nodes
one_line_what_it_does: Spatial variance and block-jackknife estimators for complete dyadic samples with spatially dependent nodes
bears_on_which_part_of_claim: Variance of pairwise statistics under spatial node dependence (superpopulation; no labelling design/prediction)

title: Limit Theory for U-Statistics under Clustered and Weakly Dependent Data
one_line_what_it_does: CLT and cluster-robust/HAC variance for order-k U-statistics under clustered/weakly dependent sampling
bears_on_which_part_of_claim: Dependent-data U-statistic theory (no labelling/prediction)

title: Cluster-Robust Variance Estimation for Dyadic Data
one_line_what_it_does: Dyadic-robust sandwich variance
bears_on_which_part_of_claim: Variance for pairwise data sharing members

title: Optimized spatial sampling of soil for estimation of the variogram by maximum likelihood
one_line_what_it_does: Optimal designs for variogram estimation; scattered clusters of closely spaced points best for weak dependence
bears_on_which_part_of_claim: Model-based block/cluster vs scattered trade-off for pair-based spatial statistics

title: Optimal network design for spatial prediction, covariance parameter estimation, and empirical prediction
one_line_what_it_does: Designs best for covariance estimation include clustered pairs; hybrid designs
bears_on_which_part_of_claim: Same trade-off, geostatistics

title: Optimized Sample Schemes for Geostatistical Surveys
one_line_what_it_does: Variogram estimation requires irregular/short-lag pairs while kriging prefers dispersed
bears_on_which_part_of_claim: Same trade-off, geostatistics

title: Spatial Spread Sampling Using Weakly Associated Vectors
one_line_what_it_does: Uses Moran's I of the design as a spatial-balance index
bears_on_which_part_of_claim: Moran's I appears as design-balance measure, not estimand

title: Corrected Moran's I statistic (MS thesis, Univ. of Utah) - UNPUBLISHED thesis
one_line_what_it_does: Estimating Moran's I from a random/importance-sampled set of pairs with error bounds; noise-corrected Moran's I
bears_on_which_part_of_claim: Sampling pairs to estimate Moran's I (computational), no prediction/design theory; unpublished

title: Benchmarking Active Spot Selection for Cost-Efficient Spatial Transcriptomics
one_line_what_it_does: Benchmarks active learning vs random selection of spots to measure, evaluating predictor PCC/Moran's I fidelity
bears_on_which_part_of_claim: ST labelling-budget selection with Moran's I fidelity as a metric; no inference/CI

title: TIDEST: post-imputation differential expression testing for spatial transcriptomics data
one_line_what_it_does: Debiased DE testing after deep-learning ST imputation accounting for prediction uncertainty and spatial confounding
bears_on_which_part_of_claim: ST post-prediction inference for DE, not pairwise/spatial-autocorrelation estimands and no labelling design

title: TISSUE: uncertainty-calibrated prediction of single-cell spatial transcriptomics improves downstream analyses
one_line_what_it_does: Conformal calibrated intervals for predicted spatial expression; uncertainty-aware downstream DE
bears_on_which_part_of_claim: Conformal ST prediction intervals, not PPI for pairwise estimands

title: Performance of deep learning methods for spatial gene expression prediction from histology images: a comprehensive assessment
one_line_what_it_does: Benchmark incl. Moran's-I-inspired agreement metric between predicted and observed spatial autocorrelation
bears_on_which_part_of_claim: ST histology-prediction methods evaluated by Moran's I with no inferential correction
